detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Lead a party of heroes through endless dungeon loops. Gather loot, unlock permanent upgrades, and build powerful synergies as you push deeper into an ever-growing incremental adventure.

Build. Loot. Loop. Grow.

Loop Dungeon - Incremental is a dungeon-crawling incremental RPG where every run makes your party stronger.

Send heroes into dangerous dungeon loops, collect valuable loot, unlock permanent upgrades, and discover powerful combinations that transform a struggling squad into an unstoppable force.

Progress never stops. Every expedition contributes to your long-term growth, opening new paths, new upgrades, and new strategies.

Create Your Team

Recruit heroes with different strengths and roles.

Build a balanced party and discover synergies between characters and upgrades.

Endless Progression

Defeat monsters, gather resources, and invest in permanent improvements.

Even after a reset, your progress continues through powerful prestige bonuses that help you reach deeper floors and unlock new opportunities.

Designed for Incremental Fans

  • Automatic combat

  • Deep progression systems

  • Prestige and permanent growth

  • Hero party management

  • Pixel-art dungeon adventure

Whether you enjoy active optimization or passive progression, there's always another upgrade waiting around the next loop.
